item.title: Aluminium Louvred Pergola 3 x 4 m (10 x 13 ft), Charcoal
item.description: This pergola gives a patio a proper roof that you control. The roof is a row of aluminium louvres that turn together on a hand crank. Open them for full light, tilt them to filter the midday sun, or close them so rain is caught by a gutter built into the frame and carried down inside one of the corner posts. The frame is extruded aluminium with a matt charcoal powder coat, so there is nothing to rust or repaint. Key features: Louvres turn from open to closed (about 150°) on a single hand crank; Built-in gutter drains rainwater down through one corner post; Extruded aluminium frame with a matt charcoal powder coat; Four 12 cm (4.7 in) square posts with base plates for fixing to concrete; Shades about 12.1 m² (130 sq ft), enough for a six-seat dining set or a corner sofa.

item.title: Cedar Wood Pergola 3 x 3 m (10 x 10 ft), Natural
item.description: A timber pergola that frames a seating area and gives climbers something to grow on. Every piece arrives cut to length and drilled, so assembly is bolting together rather than sawing. Cedar is naturally resistant to rot and insects; leave it untreated and it turns a soft silver-grey, or oil it each year to keep the warm honey colour. Key features: Kiln-dried cedar, supplied unfinished so you can oil, stain or leave it to weather; Sturdy 14 cm (5.5 in) square posts and doubled beams with shaped ends; All rafters and top slats pre-cut and pre-drilled; Galvanised bolts, screws and post base brackets included; Open roof grid ready for climbing plants, festoon lights or a shade sail.

item.title: Hardtop Gazebo 3 x 3.7 m (10 x 12 ft) with Steel Roof and Curtains, Black
item.description: If you want a cover that stays up through every season, a hardtop gazebo is the one to choose. This model pairs a galvanised steel hip roof with a black powder-coated aluminium frame, so the roof sheds rain while the frame will not rust. Beige curtains run on a track under the eaves: tie them back at the posts or draw them round for shade and privacy. Key features: Galvanised steel roof panels with a matt black baked finish; Aluminium posts and beams, powder-coated black; Four beige polyester curtains (180 g/m²) on a hidden track, with tie-backs; Covers about 11.1 m² (120 sq ft), room for a sofa set or a dining table for six; Fixing plates for concrete or timber decks, plus ground stakes.

item.title: Wall-Mounted Lean-To Pergola 3 x 3 m (10 x 10 ft) with Retractable Canopy, White
item.description: When the patio sits right outside the back door, a lean-to pergola gives shade without four posts in the way. A full-width ledger fixes to the house wall, two posts carry the front beam and the roof slopes gently away from the building. The sand-coloured canopy runs on rails beneath the rafters: pull it across on hot afternoons and push it back into neat folds when you want the sun. Key features: Aluminium wall ledger and only two front posts; Retractable polyester canopy, 180 g/m², water-repellent and UV-resistant; White powder-coated aluminium frame that will not rust; Gentle roof pitch runs rain away from the house; Fits over a patio, deck or the area outside bifold or sliding doors.

item.title: Pop-Up Gazebo 3 x 3 m (10 x 10 ft) with Mesh Netting, Sand
item.description: A shaded, bug-free space for garden parties, barbecues and events that folds away into a wheeled bag when you are done. The steel frame opens in one piece with no loose poles to sort, the two-tier top lets warm air and gusts escape, and four zipped mesh walls keep midges out while the breeze gets through. Key features: One-piece folding steel frame, no loose poles; Three-height telescopic legs with push-button locks; Vented two-tier top in 150D polyester, water-repellent with UV protection; Four zipped mesh walls with tie-backs; Wheeled bag, pegs and guy ropes included.

item.title: Modular Rattan-Effect Corner Sofa Set with Glass-Top Table, Grey
item.description: A deep, low corner sofa made of separate pieces: two corner seats, three armless middle seats and a square coffee table. Clip them together into an L-shape that seats six, or split them into a sofa and chairs around the table. The flat resin weave over a powder-coated steel frame will not crack, fade or soak up rain like natural rattan. Key features: 2 corner seats, 3 armless seats and 1 coffee table; Flat-weave PE resin in grey over a powder-coated steel frame; 13 cm (5 in) seat cushions with zipped, removable light grey covers; Coffee table with a 5 mm frosted toughened glass top; Hidden clips hold the pieces together in any layout.
item.g:product_type: Outdoor Living & Furniture > Garden Furniture Set

item.title: Acacia Wood 7-Piece Garden Dining Set
item.description: A solid hardwood dining set for long lunches and summer evenings. Acacia is a dense hardwood with a lively grain, finished here with an exterior oil that brings out its honey-brown tones. The table top is slatted so rain drains straight through, and the six chairs have slatted backs and generous seats. Key features: Solid acacia hardwood with an oiled finish; 1.83 m (6 ft) x 91 cm (36 in) table seats six; slatted top drains rain; Six armless chairs, 46 cm (18 in) seat height; Stainless steel fixings that will not stain the wood; Parasol hole with cap in the centre of the table.
item.g:product_type: Outdoor Living & Furniture > Garden Furniture Set

item.title: Aluminium Adjustable Sun Loungers, Set of 2, Black and Taupe
item.description: A pair of clean-lined loungers for a sunny patio, pool or garden. The frames are rust-free aluminium with a black powder coat, and the seats are taut textilene sling, a coated mesh that dries quickly after a swim or a shower and needs no cushions to bring in. The backrest locks in five positions, from upright for reading to flat for sunbathing. Key features: Set of two matching loungers; Rust-free aluminium frame, black powder coat; Quick-dry taupe textilene sling seat; Five-position backrest, flat to upright; Rear wheels to follow the sun.

item.title: Rope-Weave 4-Piece Garden Sofa Set with Wood-Top Coffee Table
item.description: A relaxed four-seat set for chatting over drinks. The frames are dark grey powder-coated aluminium; the backs and arms are hand-woven from round beige outdoor rope that looks soft and stays comfortable to lean on. Deep off-white cushions sit on the seats and backs, and the coffee table has a slatted acacia top. Key features: 1 two-seat sofa, 2 lounge chairs and 1 coffee table, cushions included; Rust-free aluminium frames, dark grey powder coat; Hand-woven round olefin rope, beige; Off-white cushions with water-repellent zipped covers; Coffee table with a slatted acacia top.
item.g:product_type: Outdoor Living & Furniture > Garden Furniture Set

item.title: Outdoor Canopy Daybed with Cushions, Black Aluminium Frame
item.description: A shaded outdoor bed for lazy afternoons on the deck or by the pool. Four slim posts hold a flat top frame, and a light grey canopy slides along it so you can pull shade over the whole mattress or push it back for sun. The base holds a thick mattress cushion and three back cushions, with room for two adults to stretch out. Key features: Black powder-coated aluminium frame; Sliding light grey polyester canopy, UV-resistant; 10 cm (4 in) mattress cushion and three 51 cm (20 in) back cushions with removable covers; Lying area about 190 cm (75 in) x 140 cm (55 in), room for two adults; Adjustable feet for uneven decks and patios.

item.title: Sit-On-Top Fishing Kayak 3 m (10 ft) with Paddle, Sand
item.description: A light, steady sit-on-top kayak for lakes, ponds and slow rivers. At 3 m it is short enough for one person to carry from the car to the water, and wide enough to cast comfortably from the seat. A good first fishing kayak. Key features: Rotomoulded high-density polyethylene hull in sand; Flat, wide hull for stability when casting; Padded mesh seat with adjustable backrest; Two raised rod holders and a rear tank well with bungee; Moulded carry handles; one adjustable paddle included.

item.title: Angler Kayak 3.7 m (12 ft) with Raised Frame Seat, Olive
item.description: A 3.7 m fishing kayak built for full days afloat on lakes and sheltered coast. The raised aluminium-frame seat keeps you higher and drier with a better view, and the flat non-slip deck is steady enough to stand and sight-cast. Key features: Rotomoulded HDPE hull in olive; Raised aluminium-frame mesh seat with high and low positions; Flat stand-up deck with non-slip pad; Two flush rod holders and two accessory rails; Large rear tank well with bungee for a crate or cool box.

item.title: Pedal-Drive Fishing Kayak 3.8 m (12.5 ft), Slate
item.description: Keep both hands on the rod. A pedal unit in the centre of the hull turns a small propeller, so you can hold position, troll slowly and cover water without picking up a paddle. A lever beside the seat steers the rudder. Key features: Rotomoulded HDPE hull in slate grey; Pedal drive with propeller, forward and reverse; Drive lifts out for launching and shallow water; Hand-operated rudder lever beside the seat; Raised frame seat, flush rod holders and accessory rails.

item.title: Tandem Fishing Kayak 4 m (13 ft) with Two Paddles, Sage Grey
item.description: A two-person sit-on-top for couples, friends or a parent and child. It also paddles well solo from the centre position, and four rod holders mean two anglers can fish at once. Key features: Rotomoulded HDPE hull in sage grey; Two padded seats with adjustable backrests; Centre position for solo paddling or a child; Four flush rod holders; Front and rear tank wells with bungee; two paddles included.

item.title: Inflatable Drop-Stitch Fishing Kayak 3.4 m (11 ft), Graphite
item.description: A fishing kayak for anglers without roof bars or storage space. The drop-stitch floor inflates to a firm, flat platform, and the whole kit packs into a carry bag that fits in a car boot. Key features: Reinforced PVC side tubes in graphite with sand trim; High-pressure drop-stitch floor for a firm, flat deck; Raised padded seat with backrest; Two clip-on rod holders and a front bungee net; Removable fin, paddle, hand pump and carry bag included.

item.title: Two-Post Clear-Floor Car Lift, 4.5 t (10,000 lb), Graphite
item.description: A full-height two-post lift for home garages and small workshops that need a clear floor under the car. The overhead crossbar carries the equaliser cables and hydraulic hose above the bay, so nothing crosses the floor and trolley jacks, creepers and oil drainers roll freely between the posts. Key features: Two welded steel posts in matt graphite, joined by an overhead crossbar; Four telescopic swing arms with rubber pads and stackable height adaptors; Mechanical safety locks engage automatically as the carriages rise; One hydraulic cylinder per post, synchronised by steel equaliser cables; Side-mounted electro-hydraulic power unit: push-button raise, lever lower.

item.title: Four-Post Storage and Parking Lift, 4 t (9,000 lb), Slate Grey
item.description: A drive-on four-post lift that doubles the parking in a single garage bay: store one car on the raised runways and park another underneath. Because the car sits on its wheels, it is also a handy platform for oil changes, exhaust work and detailing. Key features: Four square steel posts in matt slate grey with ladder-style lock slots; Two chequer-plate runways; inner runway adjusts for track width; Approach ramps, three drip trays and a jack tray included; Multi-position mechanical locks with one release handle; Free-standing design; anchoring recommended on level concrete.

item.title: Portable Mid-Rise Scissor Car Lift, 2.7 t (6,000 lb)
item.description: A mid-rise scissor lift that brings the car to a comfortable working height for brakes, tyres, suspension and bodywork, then lowers flat enough to stay in the bay or be wheeled aside. With nothing overhead, it works in garages with low ceilings. Key features: Double scissor frame in matt graphite with greased pivot pins; Platform with four rubber blocks for the vehicle's lifting points; Separate wheeled hydraulic power unit with hose; Detachable tow handle and wheel kit; Mechanical safety locks at several heights.

item.title: Low-Rise Portable Car Lift, 2.7 t (6,000 lb)
item.description: Two separate low-profile frames that slide under the car and lift it about 53 cm (21 in): enough to take the wheels off, rotate tyres and work on brakes and suspension without a pit or a permanent installation. They fit under most cars and stand against the wall when the job is done. Key features: Two steel lift frames in matt graphite with rubber contact pads; Shared wheeled hydraulic pump with quick-connect hoses; Lowered height of 9.5 cm (3.75 in) fits under most cars; Mechanical safety bar locks each frame at full height; No anchoring and no overhead clearance needed.

item.title: Hydraulic Motorcycle and Quad Lift Table, 680 kg (1,500 lb)
item.description: A long, flat lift table that lifts motorcycles, scooters, trail bikes and small quads to a comfortable working height. The foot pump leaves both hands free to steady the bike as it rises, and a removable rear panel gives access to the back wheel and swingarm. Key features: Steel deck in matt charcoal with a sand non-slip surface; Front wheel clamp with adjustable jaws; Removable rear drop-out panel for rear wheel removal; Foot-operated hydraulic pump with lowering pedal; Mechanical safety lock bar at working height.

item.title: Galvanised Steel Shed 3 x 2.4 m (10 x 8 ft), Slate Blue
item.description: A roomy metal shed for mowers, bikes, wheelbarrows and garden tools. Galvanised, powder-coated steel panels will not rot, split or attract insects, and the wide double doors let a ride-on mower or wheelbarrow straight in. Key features: Hot-dip galvanised steel panels, slate blue with sand trim; Low-pitch apex roof that sheds rain and snow; Wide lockable double doors; Vents under the roof line to reduce condensation; Anchor kit included.

item.title: Plastic Pent Shed 2.4 x 1.8 m (8 x 6 ft) with Floor, Sage Green
item.description: A modern pent-roof shed in tough polyethylene with a built-in floor, a strip window for daylight and lockable double doors. The panels never need painting or treating and will not rust or rot. Key features: Double-wall HDPE panels in sage green with off-white trim; Steel-reinforced pent roof sloping to the back; Heavy-duty plastic floor included; Clear window strip for natural light; Lockable double doors with lever handle.

item.title: Wooden Apex Shed 3 x 2.4 m (10 x 8 ft) with Windows, Cedar Tone
item.description: A classic apex shed with board-and-batten cladding, two windows and wide double doors. There is room for a workbench, mower and bikes, and timber walls make it easy to add shelves and hooks. Key features: Kiln-dried spruce board-and-batten cladding, cedar-tone water-based stain; Apex roof with roofing felt and bitumen shingles included; Two windows with white trim; Double doors with black steel strap hinges and hasp; Pressure-treated floor joists and floor panels included.

item.title: Lean-To Steel Shed 2.4 x 1.2 m (8 x 4 ft), Charcoal
item.description: A slim lean-to shed that stands against a house wall or fence and turns an unused side passage into storage. The single-slope roof runs water away from the wall, and the double doors open wide for tools, hoses and bins. Key features: Galvanised steel panels, charcoal with sand trim; Single-slope roof, high at the back, low at the front; Lockable double doors; Only 1.22 m (4 ft) deep, fits narrow side passages; Anchor kit included.

item.title: Horizontal Bike and Garden Store 1.8 x 0.9 m (6 x 3 ft), Olive
item.description: A low store for two bikes, a push mower or garden tools, sized to sit beside a drive or under a window. The lid lifts on gas struts and the front doors open fully, so bikes wheel straight in. Key features: Galvanised steel panels in olive with charcoal frame; Lift-up lid held open by two gas struts; Full-width double front doors; Takes two adult bikes; Lockable door handles.

item.title: Freestanding Propane Patio Heater, 13.5 kW (46,000 BTU), Graphite
item.description: A tall patio heater that keeps decks, patios and outdoor dining areas comfortable on cool evenings. The round reflector spreads heat downwards, and the base hides the gas cylinder. Key features: Steel column and reflector in matt graphite; 13.5 kW (46,000 BTU) burner with adjustable heat; Push-button piezo ignition; Tilt safety cut-off; Wheels for moving; cylinder hidden in the base.

item.title: Wall-Mounted Electric Infrared Patio Heater, 1.5 kW
item.description: A slim infrared heater for covered patios, porches and garden rooms. Infrared warms people and surfaces directly rather than the air, so it works in open-sided spaces where fan heaters struggle. No gas, no fumes, no flame. Key features: Slim graphite aluminium housing with mesh grille; 1.5 kW carbon infrared element, instant heat; Three heat settings and remote control; Adjustable wall or ceiling bracket; Weather-resistant for covered outdoor areas.

item.title: Rectangular Propane Fire Pit Table, 14.7 kW (50,000 BTU), Sand
item.description: A gas fire pit table that brings real flames to the patio without smoke, sparks or ash. The wide sand-coloured top doubles as a table for drinks and plates, and the gas cylinder sits behind a side door. Key features: Concrete-look fibre-reinforced top in sand; slate grey steel base; 14.7 kW (50,000 BTU) stainless steel burner, lava rocks included; Electronic push-button ignition and adjustable flame; Side door hides the gas cylinder; Weather cover included.

item.title: Wall-Mounted Electric Fire 127 cm (50 in) with Crystal Media
item.description: A slim 127 cm electric fire that hangs on the wall like a TV and adds a warm focal point to a living room, bedroom or office. It heats with a built-in fan heater, or runs the flame effect on its own all year round. Key features: Black toughened glass front with a thin matt black frame; LED flame effect with adjustable brightness and colour settings; Clear crystal media bed; 1.5 kW / 750 W fan heater with thermostat; Remote control and timer.

item.title: Freestanding Electric Stove Heater with Log Flame Effect, Charcoal
item.description: A compact electric stove that gives a room the look of a wood burner without a chimney, logs or ash. Stand it on a hearth, in a corner or in front of an unused fireplace and plug it in. Key features: Squared steel body in matt charcoal on four short legs; Large window with realistic resin logs and glowing ember bed; 1.5 kW / 750 W fan heater with thermostat; Flame effect runs with or without heat; Overheat protection.
